title: Saint Mirren's Last Day
summary: Tae-Jun dives through the clouds to catch the wounded Ha-Jun. Together with Min-Jae and Captain Baek, they fortify Saint Mirren University for an epic siege.

panels.shot: ha-jun plunging through the burning red clouds over seoul
panels.action: Ha-Jun falls backward through the sky, trailing blood droplets and shattered starlight particles.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun falls backward through the sky, trailing blood droplets and shattered starlight particles.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khoon ki boondon aur toote hue taron ke kanon ko peeche chhodte hue aakash mein peeche ki or girta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun diving like a golden comet catching ha-jun mid-air
panels.action: Kang Tae-Jun intercepts him at 10,000 feet, wrapping strong armored arms around Ha-Jun and deploying his glider cape.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: I've got you! Ha-Jun, breathe! Main hoon na!

panels.prose_en: Kang Tae-Jun intercepts him at 10,000 feet, wrapping strong armored arms around Ha-Jun and deploying his glider cape.
panels.prose_hi: Cong Tae-Jun ne use 10,000 feet ki unchai par rok liya, Ha-Jun ke charon or majboot bakhtarband hathiyar lapete aur apne glider cape ko tainat kiya.

panels.shot: tae-jun landing heavily in the center of saint mirren courtyard
panels.action: Tae-Jun touches down on the lawn, digging his boots deep into the turf to absorb the landing momentum.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun touches down on the lawn, digging his boots deep into the turf to absorb the landing momentum.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun lawn ko chhuta hai, landing gati ko avshoshit karne ke liye apne jute turf mein gahrai tak khodta hai.

panels.shot: min-jae and campus volunteers running out with medical kits
panels.action: Min-Jae sprints across the grass, tearing open sterile bandages and hemostatic sprays: 'Ha-Jun! What happened up there?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: He's bleeding heavily from the chest! Apply pressure!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae sprints across the grass, tearing open sterile bandages and hemostatic sprays: 'Ha-Jun! What happened up there?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ghas par teji se daudta hai, banjh pattiyon aur hemostatic spray ko faadta hai: 'Ha-Jun! wahan upar kya hua?!'

panels.shot: ha-jun gritting his teeth his hand trembling against the wound
panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches his chest: 'Kuro... It wasn't his fault... Nihilux has the Primordial Whistle...'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro ko blame mat karna... He was forced...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutches his chest: 'Kuro... It wasn't his fault... Nihilux has the Primordial Whistle...'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni chhati pakad li: 'Kuro... yah uski galti nahin thi... nihilax ke paas primerdial whistle hai...'.

panels.shot: captain baek arriving with armored section 9 transport vehicles
panels.action: Four heavy armored personnel carriers screech to a halt around the campus perimeter, deploying 50 veteran commandos.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Establish a three-tiered perimeter around Saint Mirren! This is our last fortress!

panels.prose_en: Four heavy armored personnel carriers screech to a halt around the campus perimeter, deploying 50 veteran commandos.
panels.prose_hi: Char bhari bakhtarband karmik 50 anubhavi commando ko tainat karte hue, parisar ki paridhi ke aaspaas rukte han.

panels.shot: campus entrance: student volunteers and teachers stacking sandbags
panels.action: Students, faculty, and demon soldiers work side by side, stacking sandbags and plasma turrets at the university gates.
panels.prose_en: Students, faculty, and demon soldiers work side by side, stacking sandbags and plasma turrets at the university gates.
panels.prose_hi: Chhatra, shikshak aur danav sainik ek saath milkar kaam karte han, vishwavidyalaya ke gate par ret ki boriyan aur plasma burj jama karte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun sitting against a marble pillar as min-jae wraps his chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits against a campus pillar; white bandages soak with scarlet blood as Min-Jae works with trembling hands.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Three relics were stolen... Does that mean your power is cut in half?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits against a campus pillar; white bandages soak with scarlet blood as Min-Jae works with trembling hands.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek parisar ke khambhe ke samne baithta hai; jab min-je kampate hathon se kaam karta hai to safed pattiyan lal rang ke khoon se lathpath ho jaati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun clenching his fist: 'power isn't in relics, it's in blood!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun's violet irises burn with renewed fire: 'Relics are just amplifiers. The Sovereign's Blood is mine!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Relics toot sakte hain... Par mera bloodline koi nahi cheen sakta!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's violet irises burn with renewed fire: 'Relics are just amplifiers. The Sovereign's Blood is mine!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki baingani putli nai aag se jalti hai: 'avshesh sirf pravardhak han. samprabhu ka khoon mera hai!'

panels.shot: on the horizon: ten thousand void cyber-hounds advancing across mapo bridge
panels.action: Across Mapo Bridge, an ocean of snarling chrome cyber-hounds and void abominations marches toward the campus.
panels.prose_en: Across Mapo Bridge, an ocean of snarling chrome cyber-hounds and void abominations marches toward the campus.
panels.prose_hi: Mepo bridge ke par, khunkhar chrome cyber-hound aur shunya ghrinit vastuon ka ek mahasagar parisar ki or badhta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping to the front iron gates drawing his claymore
panels.action: Tae-Jun stands at the front iron archway, planting his bronze sword into the asphalt: 'They don't pass this gate.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: This school belongs to my brother. You will die before you enter.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun stands at the front iron archway, planting his bronze sword into the asphalt: 'They don't pass this gate.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun samne ke lohe ke torandwar par khada hai, apni kansya talwar ko damar mein gaad raha hai: 've is dwar ko paar nahin karte han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun standing up beside tae-jun ignoring the pain in his ribs
panels.action: Ha-Jun pushes himself to his feet, drawing the Sanguine Fang: 'Together, Hyung. Like we promised.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pushes himself to his feet, drawing the Sanguine Fang: 'Together, Hyung. Like we promised.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khud ko apne pairon par khada karta hai, aur senguin fang ka chitran karta hai: 'ek sath, hung. jaisa ki humne vaada kiya tha.'

panels.shot: the cyber-hound vanguard charging the campus gates at 80 mph
panels.action: The front wave of two thousand metallic beasts charges the iron gates with snapping titanium jaws.
panels.prose_en: The front wave of two thousand metallic beasts charges the iron gates with snapping titanium jaws.
panels.prose_hi: Do hazar dhatvik janvaron ki samne ki lahar lohe ke darwazon ko tadakte hue titanium jabdon se charge karti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun unleashing a 50-meter bronze shockwave from his blade
panels.action: Tae-Jun sweeps his sword; a crescent wave of heavy bronze mana obliterates the first hundred hounds into scrap.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun sweeps his sword; a crescent wave of heavy bronze mana obliterates the first hundred hounds into scrap.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne apni talwar ghumai; bhari kansya maina ki ek ardhchandrakar lahar pehle sau shikari kutton ko nasht kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating chains of ruin binding the second wave
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips Chains of Ruin through the street, snaring 200 beasts in crushing gravitational coils.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whips Chains of Ruin through the street, snaring 200 beasts in crushing gravitational coils.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sadak par barbad janjeeron ko maarta hai, jisse 200 janwar gurutvakarshan kundaliyon ko kuchalne mein fans jaate han.

panels.shot: min-jae and student snipers firing plasma rifles from library roof
panels.action: From the library rooftop, Min-Jae and student snipers pick off heavy hydras with synchronized plasma fire.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Target the optics! Don't let them flank the courtyard!

panels.prose_en: From the library rooftop, Min-Jae and student snipers pick off heavy hydras with synchronized plasma fire.
panels.prose_hi: Library ki chhat se, min-je aur chhatra snipers sinkronised plasma fire ke saath bhari hydra ko hatate han.

panels.shot: demon warriors swinging battleaxes decapitating cyber-beasts
panels.action: The Iron Demon Vanguard engages in brutal hand-to-hand melee at the gatehouse, black blood splashing the walls.
panels.prose_en: The Iron Demon Vanguard engages in brutal hand-to-hand melee at the gatehouse, black blood splashing the walls.
panels.prose_hi: Lauh danav mohra gatehouse mein krur hathapai mein sanlagn hai, diwaron par kale khoon ke chhinte pad rahe han.

panels.shot: a 30-foot void brute smashing through the brick perimeter wall
panels.action: A thirty-foot armored brute with club hands smashes through the neoclassical brick wall on the east flank.
panels.prose_en: A thirty-foot armored brute with club hands smashes through the neoclassical brick wall on the east flank.
panels.prose_hi: Ek tees foot ka bakhtarband janwar apne club ke hathon se purvi kinare par navashastriy int ki deewar ko todta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun blitzing across the courtyard decapitating the brute mid-stride
panels.action: Ha-Jun blurs across the lawn, severing the brute's massive neck before the falling bricks hit the grass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blurs across the lawn, severing the brute's massive neck before the falling bricks hit the grass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun lawn mein ghumta hai, girti inton ke ghas se takraane se pehle janwar ki vishal gardan cut jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun coughing a spray of blood onto his sleeve from chest strain
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands, coughing scarlet blood into his sleeve as his unhealed chest wound reopens painfully.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ugh... Without the Ashen Heart, my internal organs are overheating...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands, coughing scarlet blood into his sleeve as his unhealed chest wound reopens painfully.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni aasteen mein lal rang ka khoon bahate hue jameen par utarta hai kyonki uski chhati ka theek na hua ghav dardnak tarike se phir se khul jata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun rushing over catching ha-jun before he stumbles
panels.action: Tae-Jun catches him by the elbow: 'Ha-Jun! Fall back to the library! I will hold the gatehouse!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Library mein jao! Let me buy you time to heal!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun catches him by the elbow: 'Ha-Jun! Fall back to the library! I will hold the gatehouse!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne use kohni se pakad liya: 'Ha-Jun! pustakalaya mein wapas aao! main gatehouse pakdunga!

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking his head pushing tae-jun hand gently away
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into his brother's eyes with fierce pride: 'I spent seven years running and hiding. I will never run again.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main ab kabhi peeche nahi hatunga. We stand or fall here.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks into his brother's eyes with fierce pride: 'I spent seven years running and hiding. I will never run again.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bhai ki aankhon mein behad garv ke saath dekhta hai: 'maine saat saal bhagte aur chhipte hue bitaye. main phir kabhi nahin daudunga.'

panels.shot: the sky darkening as a massive shadow descends: emperor nihilux
panels.action: The crimson sky turns pitch-black; floating down from the clouds comes Emperor Nihilux himself.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: How touching. Two mortal brothers dying in the ruins of their school.

panels.prose_en: The crimson sky turns pitch-black; floating down from the clouds comes Emperor Nihilux himself.
panels.prose_hi: Lal rang ka aakash ekdum kala ho jata hai; samrat nihilax swayam baadalon se tairte hue neeche aate han.

panels.shot: beside nihilux: kuro perched on his iron shoulder his eyes glowing toxic green
panels.action: Perched on Nihilux's shoulder is Kuro—his feathers bristling with green void miasma, looking down blankly.
panels.prose_en: Perched on Nihilux's shoulder is Kuro—his feathers bristling with green void miasma, looking down blankly.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ke kandhe par Kuro baitha hai - uske pankh hare rang ke shunya miyasma se chamak rahe han, jo khali neeche dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at kuro his heart breaking in his chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his corrupted companion, whispering with raw, choked love: 'Kuro... It's me. Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro... Meri aawaz suno... It's Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his corrupted companion, whispering with raw, choked love: 'Kuro... It's me. Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bhrasht saathi ko dekhta hai, kacche, dabe hue pyar se fusfusata hai: 'Kuro... yah main hun. Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: kuro eye twitching violently as a single tear falls from his beak
panels.action: Deep inside the void possession, Kuro's consciousness thrashes; a single crystal tear falls from his eye.
panels.prose_en: Deep inside the void possession, Kuro's consciousness thrashes; a single crystal tear falls from his eye.
panels.prose_hi: Shunya aadhipatya ke bhitar gahre men, Kuro ki chetna chhatpatati hai; uski aankh se ek crystaliy aansu girta hai.

panels.shot: nihilux laughing cruelly raising his dark execution lance
panels.action: Nihilux sneers: 'Your crow cannot hear you, insect. He belongs to the Void now!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Prepare to join your parents in the dust of history!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux sneers: 'Your crow cannot hear you, insect. He belongs to the Void now!'.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ne vyangya kiya: 'tumhara kauwa tumhe nahin sun sakta, kit. wah ab shunya ka hai!'

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping in front of ha-jun spreading his arms wide
panels.action: Tae-Jun positions his 6-foot frame directly between Nihilux's lance and Ha-Jun's bleeding chest.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: YOU WILL HAVE TO GO THROUGH ME FIRST, COWARD!!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun positions his 6-foot frame directly between Nihilux's lance and Ha-Jun's bleeding chest.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apne 6 foot ke frame ko sidhe nihilax ke lance aur Ha-Jun ki khoon bah rahi chhati ke beech rakhta hai.

panels.shot: nihilux thrusting the execution lance forward at supersonic speed
panels.action: Nihilux thrusts the 10-foot black lance forward, the tip whistling with the force of an anti-tank shell.
panels.prose_en: Nihilux thrusts the 10-foot black lance forward, the tip whistling with the force of an anti-tank shell.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ne 10 foot ke kale lance ko aage ki or dhakela, jiska sira anti-tank shell ke bal se ct baja raha tha.

panels.shot: the lance tip inches from tae-jun chestplate cliffhanger
panels.action: The obsidian lance tip is two inches from Tae-Jun's chest as Ha-Jun screams his brother's name in terror!
panels.prose_en: The obsidian lance tip is two inches from Tae-Jun's chest as Ha-Jun screams his brother's name in terror!.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian lance tip Tae-Jun ki chhati se do inch door hai kyonki Ha-Jun dar ke maare apne bhai ka naam chillata hai!
